meta.title: Request Best Offer from all vendors during Evaluation
gaps: Real-time updates as vendors submit new quotations
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: System email delivery to vendors; Real-time updates as vendors submit new quotations

steps.note: Open the existing RFQ with vendor quotes for the Evaluation-stage scenario.
Open the event Settings action that starts the Best Offer request flow.

args.goal: In the Request for Best Offer side panel, enter a valid Best Offer submission duration, invite all vendors, click Send Request, and stop on the event screen showing the Best Offer Requested tag and that status on every vendor bid card or row.

steps.note: Perform the panel-specific duration, vendor invitation, and send actions, then verify the on-screen event and vendor-row outcomes.
Assert that the event displays the expected Best Offer Requested status tag.
